title: Boat to Plate
logline: A net comes up at dawn on an open beach, and what is inside it is auctioned, carried, cooked and eaten inland before the day is out, each stage existing only because of the one before it.

object.note: Object 9 (identity not chosen) may appear subtly, for example among Chathura's things while he travels, waits or watches, only where it sits naturally in a real moment. Never staged, never the subject. Object 2, from Wanting, may also recur along a chain that runs from contact to appetite.

thread_in.thread: From causes found inside one machine to a chain spread across one day: a fish netted at dawn on the west coast and eaten inland by nightfall.

thread_out.thread: A chain followed forward becomes a chain that can be entered anywhere: cane cutters pulling a vine's hidden length from wherever they first grasp it.

requirements: A working beach landing site with a visible auction
A traceable vendor's round reaching a specific inland kitchen
Cooperation from fishers, auctioneers, a vendor and a household, all within one day's chain

lesson.in_simple_terms: Each stage of the fish's day exists only because of the stage before it. The Abhidhamma describes a whole human life with the same kind of sentence, repeated link by link: because of this, that.
lesson.in_simple_terms_si: මාළුවාගේ ගමනේ සෑම පියවරක්ම පෙර පියවර නිසාම පවතින්නාක් මෙන්, අභිධර්මය මුළු ජීවිතයක්ම 'මෙය නිසා එය' යන එකම වාක්‍ය රටාවෙන් පටිච්ච සමුප්පාදය ලෙස දක්වයි.
lesson.the_teaching: The Pāli formula of dependent origination is one sentence pattern repeated eleven times, 'with this as condition, that', joining twelve links from ignorance to ageing and death and closing with 'thus arises this whole mass of suffering'. Each clause takes what the last one produced and hands it on. The texts add that each step names only the principal cause among many, and Margaya tells the student to learn the formula by heart before its meaning is explained.
lesson.how_the_film_shows_it: Nets come up at first light, the catch is sorted on the sand, the auction runs on fast calls and hand signals, and a vendor carries it door to door inland until a family eats. No one names the links; the viewer notices that no stage makes itself, and that the hands at either end of the day will never meet.
lesson.caution: The fish's journey echoes the formula's grammar, not its twelve links, and the formula is not a simple domino chain with one cause per step.
lesson.builds_on: After a machine that stopped for several reasons at once, this film follows a chain forward through a single day and meets the sentence the texts use for the whole of a life: because of this, that.
lesson.evidence_class: editorial interpretation grounded in cited source teaching
